proposed_facts.reason: Canonical declarations show four callback records, the last null, and a StageData descriptor. Narrowing to source-level types appropriately avoids unsupported compiled-section claims.

The static cache and eight pointer fields match the proposal, including the unusual declaration order. Selection branches establish semantic surface groups without establishing byte offsets or small-BSS membership.
Load is empty; initialization and start are separate callbacks. The start callee creates and schedules a manager and publishes its data rather than immediately creating targets.
StageData registers the empty load endpoint separately from initialization and manager startup, supporting the corrected purpose.

The static void(void) declaration and ordinary wrapper body establish a local callback, not a non-returning function. The delegated creation routine explicitly returns on success and GObj-creation failure.

Initialization caches the parameter pointer. Selection rejects -1 and unsupported joints/kinds, directly returns descriptor fields, and has no cache null check or local mutation. Parameter lifetime remains an explicit prerequisite rather than an ownership claim.
